steps.title: 工具 schema 校验器
steps.why: 先把「一次工具调用是否合法」变成纯函数，后面的循环才有可断言的边界
steps.why_en: Turn 'is this tool call legal' into a pure function so the loop has an assertable boundary

steps.title: ReAct 循环状态机
steps.why: 让 Agent 有一轮可观测的循环边界，模型回复全部作为 fixture 入参
steps.why_en: Give the agent an observable one-round boundary; every model reply is a fixture argument

steps.title: 记忆账本与确定性压缩
steps.why: 把循环轨迹写成可回放的账本，长对话才能有界且可复现
steps.why_en: Write loop traces into a replayable ledger so long dialogues stay bounded and reproducible

steps.title: 重试退避与熔断预算
steps.title_en: Retry Backoff and Circuit Breaker Budget
steps.why: 失败也要是确定性的：退避是算出来的计划，不是真的 sleep 或随机抖动
steps.why_en: Failures must be deterministic too: backoff is a computed plan, not a real sleep or random jitter

steps.title: 多轮脚本化对话终局验收
steps.why: 把前四块拼成一条数据流，断言每轮工具调用序列、断点与最终答案
steps.why_en: Assemble the previous four blocks into one data flow and assert tool-call sequences, breakpoints and final answers

steps.title: L4 设计复盘：为什么不能有状态判题
steps.title_en: L4 Design Review: Why Stateful Judging Is Forbidden
steps.why: 收尾用排序/判定题考整体认知，把项目从「会写」推到「知道为什么这么切」
steps.why_en: Close with an ordering/judgement question to move from 'can build it' to 'knows why it is cut this way'
